predictions.prediction_text: If the Fed does not cut, there will be no yield relief, no cash out of MMFs, and the liquidity-driven equity rally will significantly unwind.

predictions.prediction_text: As Treasury issuance outstrips MMF absorption capacity, yields will spike and liquidity will decline, causing the liquidity-driven rally to unravel.
predictions.expected_result: Rising net Treasury supply coincides with a sharp increase in yields and a measurable drop in equity liquidity, followed by equity price declines.
